changelog: Clearer disclosure of what is stored and where
summary: Runs an online store end to end: catalog, checkout, payments, inventory, fulfillment, returns, pricing, conversion, retention, and tax. Use when building or reviewing store code — checkout totals, webhooks, stock decrements; when a payment double-charges, a webhook replays, or an order is paid but missing in the store; when stock oversells across channels or a reorder point is missing; when carts abandon, conversion drops, or AOV has to rise; when a discount or free-shipping threshold might sell below cost; when chargebacks, refund abuse, or fraud rules need setting; when choosing or migrating a platform or adding a marketplace; when VAT/OSS, sales-tax nexus, or a 14-day withdrawal window applies; and for peak season, subscriptions, and wholesale terms. Not for parcel carrier depth (skill `shipping`), payment-provider integration code (skill `payments`), CRO method (skill `conversion-rate-optimization`), SaaS pricing (skill `pricing`), or a physical shop (skill `store`).
